steps: Tall canopy trees (sun plants) predominantly absorb blue and red wavelengths of solar radiation.
The filtered sunlight reaching the understory (herbs and shrubs) is depleted in blue and red light.
Consequently, herbs and shrubs receive a higher proportion of transmitted green (and far-red) light.
Since green light is least absorbed by chlorophyll pigments, the rate of photosynthesis in herbs and shrubs is relatively low.
